use_case: Ambient clinical documentation (AI scribe): records the visit and drafts the visit note for the physician to edit and sign
vendor_or_model: AI scribe vendor (generative speech-to-text and language model, vendor SaaS on a practice tablet)
source_evidence: EV-023 (trial account and draft BAA); EV-017 (BAA folder); EV-036 (staff survey)
data_categories: Visit audio; transcripts; draft clinical notes (ePHI)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation only); becomes Health care if diagnosis, order, or coding suggestions are enabled
human_in_the_loop: Physician reviews, edits, and signs every note; attestation at signing; can stop recording at any time
applicable_laws: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (BAA required before ePHI); Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) all-party prior consent to recording; 45 CFR 92.210 if clinical suggestion features are enabled
status: Pilot (1 physician); recording paused from 2026-08-31 until the BAA is signed
